shape_hint: Single Belleville disc spring: a thin annular ring pressed into a shallow cone, plain outer and inner diameters (no teeth or slots), so in section it is a slanted flat ring of thickness t with cone height h0 above it; top view is a plain annulus.

role_map.De: outer diameter of the disc spring, tolerance h12 (nominal = max)
role_map.Di: inner diameter of the disc spring, tolerance H12 (nominal = min)
role_map.t: material thickness (for group 3 springs the reduced thickness t' is not listed here)
role_map.l0: free (unloaded) overall height of the single spring; h0 = l0 - t is the cone height

notes: Only 8 of the roughly 100 standard sizes could be verified with 3 independent sources. Rows 1-7 have the proportions of the thin/light series (De/t about 17.5-20, h0/t 0.38-0.5) and row 8 (40x20.4x1) the thin-series proportions (De/t=40, h0/t=1.3); DIN 2093 series letters A/B/C were not confirmed by 3 sources and are therefore not part of the table. Group 1 (t<1.25 mm) and group 2 (t 1.25-6 mm) only. Each row is a distinct part number (De x Di x t); disc springs of the same De/Di but another t exist in the standard. EN 16983 replaced DIN 2093 (ferratec: 'DIN EN 16983 (ehemals DIN 2093)'). The table is a starting point only; more distributor tables are needed (no further web discovery was possible: WebSearch budget exhausted).

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched all 6 listed URLs live (HTTP 200) + fasteners.eu DIN 2093. Built tuple sets (De,Di,t,l0): FE/torqbolt 29, ferratec 276, boltsfastener 159, lexikon 36, fuller 29, schnorr 20. Rows 1-7 (8x4.2x0.4/0.6, 10x5.2x0.5/0.75, 14x7.2x0.8/1.1, 16x8.2x0.9/1.25, 18x9.2x1/1.4, 20x10.2x1.1/1.55, 28x14.2x1.5/2.15): exact tuple in FE-cluster, ferratec(+boltsfastener) and lexikon = 3 clusters, no source lists a different l0 for the same De/Di/t. Row 8 (40x20.4x1/2.3): fuller, ferratec(+boltsfastener), schnorr = 3 clusters, no conflicting l0. Merge test: boltsfastener vs ferratec identical on 137/142 overlapping rows -> one cluster (confirmed). lexikon vs ferratec: 19/36 tuples identical but 15 have the same De/Di/t with different l0 (and 2 unmatched) -> not a copy, counted separate. fuller 29/29 and FE 28/29 of their rows also exist in ferratec (catalogue stocks the whole standard) - not a copy relation. Physical: De/Di 1.90-1.97, l0>t, h0=l0-t = 0.20,0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40,0.45,0.65 (match FE h0 column) and 1.30.
problems: Every cell is supported by exactly 3 clusters after merging boltsfastener into ferratec and torqbolt into fasteners.eu; zero margin.

l0 role: explicit in FE ('l0'), ferratec ('lo'), schnorr ('l0 [mm]'); lexikon ('h') and fuller ('h', with h1 = cone height h0) are generic/inferred by arithmetic (h = t + h0). Rows 1-7 rely on lexikon h and row 8 on fuller h as one of the three.

Row 8 is a different series (De/t=40, h0/t=1.3) from rows 1-7 (De/t~18-20, h0/t~0.4-0.5); series letters not confirmed by sources. The table is a sparse selection (8 of ~100 sizes), not a series table.
De h12 max=nominal and Di H12 min=nominal confirmed by fuller/FE headers. Group-3 reduced thickness t' not applicable.
Standard label: DIN 2093 vs EN 16983 (ferratec: 'DIN EN 16983 ehemals DIN 2093') - catalog must pick one.
